problems: lohara-dynasty, utpala-dynasty and kashmir are one realm on the same land; Cliopatria's Lohara shapes (15 shapes, 597-765 cells over Gilgit-Baltistan, Xinjiang and the Pamirs, Valley missing) are wrong and were replaced by the Kashmir dossier's land; draw only one of the three.
Cliopatria's Sena row draws all Bengal (905 cells) from 1072; the pages support Rarh until 1152; 7 of 11 Sena keyframes are wrong.
Cliopatria's Hoysala shapes of 1250-1325 drop the south (Mysuru, Hassan, Talakadu, Hosur); adjusted to the 1241 outline; the 1344 shape is Vijayanagara land and is wrong.

Start/end years differ from Cliopatria in all six: lohara 1003-1320 (row to 1259), hoysala 1108-1343 (1111-1344), sena 1070-1230 (1072-1235), eastern-ganga 1078-1434 (1056-1351), gahadavala 1085-1194 (to 1201), polonnaruwa 1070-1236 (1072-1259); reasons in each dossier's notes.

Cliopatria's Polonnaruwa row draws the whole island 1072-1249, but the Parakramabahu I page divides it in three for 1111-1152; its 1250-1259 shape lies after the dossier's end; the ceylon and kingdom-of-dambadeniya rows overlap it for 1236-1259.

validator warnings left (counterpart slugs with no dossier): suryavamsha-dynasty (eastern-ganga-kingdom), varman-dynasty-of-east-bengal and deva-dynasty (sena-dynasty); no gazetteer resolve warnings (missing places were replaced by lon/lat discs or nearby districts).

Mirror events other dossiers should carry: mongol-empire (Kashmir vassal after 1235), vijayanagara-empire (Hoysala land from 1344), ghurid-dynasty (Gahadavala land 1195-1201), khalji-dynasty (Hoysala tribute after 1311), chola-empire (Rameswaram 1167-1182 with kingdom-of-polonnaruwa); chandela-kingdom holds a 1085 loss to gahadavala-dynasty that the Gahadavala page does not mention.
